decisions.reason: The FAQ state contains no Aave technology or prize-pool yield claim that must be removed, and the source only says the FAQs still need unspecified updates.
Removing Aave references from About-page content does not change automatic prize transfer or the winner-wallet payout destination.
The Mission-page state does not mention Aave or prize-pool yield generation, so its content remains valid unchanged.
Aave removal does not alter Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, selection eligibility, or on-chain winner selection.
Badge definitions, milestones, storage, and cosmetic effects are independent of Aave integration and the About-page wording change.
The target blockchain remains Base; removing an Aave integration reference does not change network deployment.
The source does not change mint price, founder or referral allocations, or the rule that residual proceeds fund the prize pools.
Royalty amount, enforcement, founder share, and prize-pool destinations remain valid without Aave yield generation.
The Big Block prize amount, winner count, sales trigger, and funding sources are not changed by removal of Aave integration.
The mention of doing Transak in a couple of days is project scheduling, not a change to the provider, payment methods, fulfillment behavior, or deferred lifecycle state.
Aave removal and About-page wording changes do not affect which NFT-associated book, referral, badge, or ticket state transfers on resale.
The no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, and allocated commission and tickets remain unchanged.
